answer: A model needs an accurate continuation-state description/adapter when first integrated, not a new cache manager for every model, quantized repository or backend. Models in the same state family can share a parameterized adapter. New state mathematics or storage representation may still require a real primitive/reader extension; existing operators alone do not prove the model adapter works.

scope.authority: The existing eight-model current_scope and model-operators table only; preview DeepSeek and all newer/unlisted models are excluded.

source_notes: Archive members from model-quantization-discovery are already cached fixed descendant artifact configs; their architecture fields are used as recorded evidence, not proof of upstream latest state, checkpoint numeric values or Hyle execution.

GLM official config extraction preserves repository/revision identity. The additional MLX reader is pinned by glm_reader_revision (mlx-vlm f1a9b7bac6f2b95f588ffc9343495a3c61c6e328) and is distinguished from the official publisher implementation.
Formal Pro/Flash source members have identical SHA c0c19e6c9fa439bac7fbb1c5bc1868232dfd5aa2f439a548d0e33dcc2a9edd3f; the separate GA configs, layer schedules and TopK differ.
Anchors use source IDs above with line ranges or exact JSON pointers. This is a source/cached-evidence review, not a new model-support status.

common_boundary.contract: Weights, immutable Executable/family children and model state schema are shared. Session index is not a provider identity and each session has its own mutable Invocation/bindings and committed position/state.

StateSchema/Store/Version/Head hold fixed typed resource members and copied host metadata; ReadLease/StateWriter/CloneTicket enforce original ownership and native retirement. PagedArena holds exact ready/pending page guards. Their logic is reused across state families; it does not infer model semantics.

Declare every persistent tensor and metadata field, shape/dtype/codec, query/history update ports, per-token/chunk ordering, valid lengths/positions, and one successful whole-model publication boundary. A prefix fork must preserve the full model state at that boundary. Replaying omitted history is an explicit charged fallback, not an implicit KV-only restoration.

SessionCache handles resident count and owner-reported requested bytes at admission/idle boundaries. Engine decides active windows, LRU/prefix identity and eviction; exact page/shared backing budgets and in-flight retirement remain in the resource owners. Erasing a directory does not free retained native storage.

An existing typed state update/reader runs through its original backend and Execution/Invocation/Queue lifetime. Bind actual resource/representation and qualify geometry/numerics; no per-model backend allowlist or second executor is implied.

quantization_and_prefix_identity.principle: Quantization is part of the compatibility identity, not a reason to implement another LRU/cache system.
include_in_identity: exact model/weights revision and adapter parameters
actual token prefix, positions and RoPE/config semantics
cache representation/dtype/codec and any fixed/dynamic scale interpretation
quantized model/activation math and rounding policy that generated the state
compatible physical resource/layout and original owner/generation when sharing backing
quantization_and_prefix_identity.must_not_assume: Same base model name, same bit width, equal tensor shape or weight quantization label does not prove state values/codec are shareable. A change limited to a genuinely identical cache-format adapter may reuse machinery, but must not reuse incompatible state bytes.

remaining_global_boundaries: Current proven real multi-session model consumer is Qwen3.5-2B text. Do not promote the other seven from finite operator/role tests to complete model adapters.

Model-wide immutable snapshots must publish all KV/conv/GDN/KDA/compressor/index members and position metadata together; a ready page and a separate successful state head are not automatically an atomic whole-model state.
StateVersion has fixed resource/metadata members; variable PagedArenaRead page lists remain typed owning frames in an engine snapshot aggregate, not serialized owning C++ handles in metadata bytes.

New paged append proof covers original shared CPU/CUDA plain F16/BF16 fresh/COW writes, selected artifacts and explicit DAG edges. Native Apple/Vulkan/encoded writers and exclusive in-place append are separate scopes. The symbolic-rows work in progress is not signed by earlier fixed-row tests.

Prefix reuse at a saved complete-state boundary can share immutable owners. Arbitrary token cuts/rollback and MTP/DSpark accepted-prefix commit need complete saved state or explicit source-correct replay; no automatic generic proof exists.

Do not retain every mathematical output as continuation cache: AttnRes/mHC residuals and coefficients and cross-layer TopK reuse can be intra-forward scratch. Persist them only where the selected model actually carries them across the saved continuation/draft boundary.
decision: Keep one common cache/resource lifecycle. Implement or parameterize model state descriptions by these families, then run a real full-state continuation/prefix journey per adapter. Extend a primitive only for a proven math/representation gap, not because the model has another name.
